method: Compare with DESI VI; convert z to a with half-up rounding on the printed digits (G5); recompute z_p from the public DESI DR1 chains with the DETF definition 1 - a_p = -Cov(w0, wa)/Var(wa).
text: The pivot redshifts found in DESI VI are z_p = 0.26 (PantheonPlus and DESY5) and 0.33 (Union3), i.e. a_p = 0.79 and 0.75.
rests_on: Every PhantomX statement (C4, C6, C8) is made at these pivots.
